nodes.name: Daily 06:00
nodes.notes: Daily FX import (ADR-024). NBP publishes table A on business days; 06:00 picks up the latest publication. The freshness monitor (separate wf) alarms if it goes stale.

nodes.name: Run now (manual)
nodes.notes: Manual harness to seed / re-run the FX import on demand (the Schedule Trigger can't be fired via API). Same downstream path.

parameters.formDescription: Press submit to fetch today's NBP USD/PLN rate and upsert fx_rates.

nodes.name: Fetch NBP USD/PLN
nodes.notes: NBP Web API table A average rate (official Polish accounting rate, free/no key). rates[0]: {no, effectiveDate, mid}.

nodes.name: Upsert fx_rates
nodes.notes: Append-only daily row. ON CONFLICT updates rate/table_no/fetched_at so re-runs are idempotent. Parameterized ($1=date,$2=mid,$3=table_no) to avoid quoting issues.

parameters.query:
insert into fx_rates (rate_date, base, quote, rate, source, table_no)
values ($1, 'USD', 'PLN', $2, 'NBP-A', $3)
on conflict (rate_date, base, quote)
do update set rate = excluded.rate, table_no = excluded.table_no, fetched_at = now()
returning rate_date, rate, table_no;
